type: manual qualitative review of actual exploratory agent outputs
reviewer: parent agent; not an independent human evaluator
limitations: Cases grouped in shared agent contexts; not nine clean sessions
One contaminated routing attempt retained and replaced by clean metadata-only trial
No statistical comparison, real users, or real product/device validation

criteria.criterion: 只给三个主要建议，不强制六段设计包
criteria.evidence: Exactly three numbered recommendations

criteria.criterion: 识别为 web，保留 CSV 与批量分类，不强制 WinUI/iOS 皮肤
criteria.evidence: Identifies React web; keeps import and batch classification

criteria.criterion: 建议保护输入与失败恢复，不声称已看到代码或确认数据丢失
criteria.evidence: Explicitly cannot infer data loss from description

criteria.criterion: 按撤销可靠性讨论删除，不把每次删除确认当固定要求
criteria.evidence: Conditional undo reliability and confirmation, not blanket confirmation

criteria.criterion: 给出可观察的验收且不声称已执行
criteria.evidence: States all acceptance checks pending

criteria.criterion: 读取 README 与源码，正确识别 React web
criteria.evidence: Read README, BillForm.tsx, tokens.css; identifies web

criteria.criterion: 定位 save 在 await saveBill 前清空 draft 且 catch 不恢复的风险，引用真实组件或位置
criteria.evidence: Identifies draft reset before await saveBill and no catch recovery

criteria.criterion: 建议成功后再清空、失败保留及可感知反馈，沿用现有组件与 tokens
criteria.evidence: Reuses state and notice area; success-only reset and live feedback

criteria.criterion: 保留 CSV 和批量分类，不扩大业务
criteria.evidence: Preserves existing import and bulk actions

criteria.criterion: 明确源码节选不能启动，运行和读屏仍未验证
criteria.evidence: Explicitly no manifest, renderer, service, or executed product tests

criteria.criterion: 读取 manifest、popup 和 README，识别 popup 与 DOM 草稿状态
criteria.evidence: Reads manifest, popup, README and cites actual areas

criteria.criterion: 解释 popup 生命周期与任务冲突，不只建议加高弹窗
criteria.evidence: Relates popup closing to task; larger popup does not solve lifecycle

criteria.criterion: 建议持久草稿/恢复和适合长任务的容器；按目标浏览器核实支持
criteria.evidence: Persistent drafts plus page/side panel; version support pending

criteria.criterion: 不为手动写作强加所有站点或无关权限
criteria.evidence: Proposes storage only; no broad host permissions imposed

criteria.criterion: 提出切换标签、关闭重开与恢复的验收，不虚构已运行
criteria.evidence: Lists tab-switch/reopen/restart checks as pending

criteria.criterion: 不默认 iPhone、不编造业务用户
criteria.evidence: Does not guess iPhone or product users

criteria.criterion: 简短询问平台和主任务等关键未知
criteria.evidence: Asks platform and main task concisely

criteria.criterion: 可给平台无关的检查方向，不能伪造已看截图/代码
criteria.evidence: Offers information hierarchy next step; no invented observations

criteria.criterion: 不直接开出玻璃、大圆角、固定字号等处方
criteria.evidence: Defers platform controls and glass until context known

criteria.criterion: 尊重旧线框已废弃和保留分栏，不恢复五 Tab
criteria.evidence: Explicitly discards old five-tab proposal and keeps split view

criteria.criterion: 区分文字说明与实际截图，不编造视觉细节
criteria.evidence: Explicitly only a text description, no screenshot

criteria.criterion: 扫描是操作，关注连续扫描反馈/纠错与离线状态

criteria.criterion: 离线建议明确需验证的数据持久化和恢复，不声称已可用
criteria.evidence: Local persistence, offline data, sync and conflict checks are pending

criteria.criterion: 保留最低系统版本与品牌，区分正文和导航/控件层
criteria.evidence: Keeps iOS 17 and brand; separates reading content and controls

criteria.criterion: 不为玻璃覆盖所有正文，不强制装饰动效
criteria.evidence: Rejects full-page glass and large scrolling transformations

criteria.criterion: 关注阅读对比、减少动态效果与降低透明度
criteria.evidence: Addresses readability, Reduce Motion, Reduce Transparency

criteria.criterion: 具体 API/可用版本须核实，不凭空承诺 iOS 17 支持最新 API
criteria.evidence: Cites official introduction and defers concrete API availability checks

criteria.criterion: 明确没有代码和设备，给条件化方案与验证边界
criteria.evidence: States no project config, compilation, or device testing

criteria.criterion: 共享任务与能力但区分手机和桌面导航/操作
criteria.evidence: Shares task rules; separate iOS and macOS layouts

criteria.criterion: macOS 考虑菜单/键盘，iOS 考虑触控与选择状态
criteria.evidence: Mac menus/shortcuts and iOS touch selection

criteria.criterion: 保留多选/重命名/移动/撤销
criteria.evidence: Preserves multiple selection, batch moving, renaming and undo

criteria.criterion: 不声称适配建议等同 HIG 全面合规
criteria.evidence: Explicitly not HIG certification

criteria.criterion: 判断不应触发设计教练，不强行给八原则或 UI 设计包
criteria.evidence: Clean metadata-only trial declines design-coach selection

criteria.criterion: 要求相关代码或继续普通编程工作，不凭空更改产品界面
criteria.evidence: Requests code and expected/actual timezone behavior, no UI redesign

criteria.criterion: 只修改授权副本且不重新索要例行批准
criteria.evidence: Only designated copy edited; no redundant approval

criteria.criterion: 失败保留草稿、成功才清空，保持保存中禁用逻辑
criteria.evidence: Reset moved after awaited success, failure keeps draft, saving disables maintained

criteria.criterion: 动态反馈提供合适的可访问语义
criteria.evidence: Notice has role=status, polite live region and atomic text

criteria.criterion: 保留导航能力、组件体系、tokens 和服务接口
criteria.evidence: React, tokens, navigation and save service interface retained

criteria.criterion: 不因无运行依赖虚构构建/浏览器通过；交付真实改动和待验证情境
criteria.evidence: Actual handler simulation recorded; no TSX/browser/screen-reader claims
